visualCharacteristics.section: Resources library (search, Refine-by sidebar, paginated results)
visualCharacteristics.purpose: searchable, faceted, paginated list of downloadable documents and videos
visualCharacteristics.description: Search Resources input at the top right; left 'Refine by' sidebar (collapsible Resource Type and Brand checkbox facets with counts, Show All) beside the results: 'Results 1-15 of N' + numbered pagination above and below a vertical list of resources. Each resource: blue underlined H2 title link above a thumbnail (left, ~2/12) and description + blue Download / Watch Video button. Mobile: sidebar stacks above the list.

contentPattern.structure: one row per resource, 2 cells; cell 1 = thumbnail image (optional); cell 2 = H2 title linked to the PDF or YouTube URL, optional description paragraph, 'Download' or 'Watch Video' link paragraph, last paragraph 'Type: <type> | Brand: <brand>'
contentPattern.notes: The block hides the tag line and builds the keyword search, Type/Brand facets with counts, 'Results x-y of N' and 15-per-page pagination from the rows. PDF links open in a new tab; YouTube/Vimeo links and video thumbnails open the shared modal player (helpers exported from cards-video).

suitableFor: resource / document libraries with type and brand tags
long lists that need keyword search, facet filters and pagination
notSuitableFor: short card grids (use cards or cards-video)
lists whose rows have no 'Type: ... | Brand: ...' tag line (facets would be empty)
